items.raw_excerpt: People who are dating love to talk about their hopes and fears and people who aren't love to hear about them. Here’s our guide to the German phrases you need to know to get in on the dating conversation.
items.summary_en: German speakers love to discuss their feelings about dating. This guide teaches you key German phrases for talking about love and relationships. Learn words like Liebeskummer to join the conversation naturally.

items.title_en: German Dating Phrases: How to Talk About Love Like a Local
items.title_ko: 독일 데이트 표현: 현지인처럼 사랑 이야기하는 법

items.summary_en: The Local France shares six useful articles about living in France this autumn. Topics include free festivals, new electronic billing rules, a mysterious road sign, and changes to rental laws.

items.raw_excerpt: Blending in with the locals in a new country is never easy, so at least make sure you avoid these Danish social faux-pas.
items.summary_en: This article lists seven social taboos that newcomers should avoid in Denmark. Breaking these rules can upset locals and make it hard to blend in. The guide helps expats and visitors understand Danish culture and etiquette.

items.raw_excerpt: Waiting for a response from the Norwegian Directorate of Immigration (UDI) does more than delay paperwork. It disrupts the lives of those moving to Norway. Readers of The Local shared how this uncertainty prevents them from working or traveling abroad.
items.summary_en: Waiting for a response from the Norwegian Directorate of Immigration disrupts the lives of those moving to Norway. The long delays prevent many from working or traveling abroad. Readers shared how this uncertainty makes them feel trapped.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이 이민국의 답변을 기다리는 것은 단순한 서류 지연을 넘어섭니다. 노르웨이로 이주하는 사람들의 삶을 크게 방해하고 있습니다. 독자들은 그 불확실성 때문에 일이나 해외여행이 전혀 가능하지 않다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: 'I'm a prisoner': Foreigners in Norway left unable to work or travel as they wait for UDI

items.title_original: 'I'm a prisoner': Foreigners in Norway left unable to work or travel as they wait for UDI

items.raw_excerpt: You’ve probably seen them because they’re hard to miss–hundreds of large, white building blocks stacked several feet high near the new overpass project by Banwell Road and E.C. Row Expressway Interchange.
items.summary_en: Windsor is building the approach to a new overpass with giant foam blocks. The large white blocks are stacked several feet high near Banwell Road. They are hard to miss for drivers passing by.

items.raw_excerpt: Australians now make up the majority of foreign clients at dentists in Vietnam, as increasing numbers of Australians seek cheaper, quicker dental procedures in Asia. But Australian dentists are worried.
items.summary_en: A growing number of Australians are flying to Vietnam for dental work because it costs less and is faster. Vietnamese dentists now see more Australian patients than any other foreign group. Australian dentists are concerned about losing business to overseas clinics.
items.summary_ko: 호주인들의 베트남 치과 관광이 빠르게 늘고 있다. 가격이 저렴하고 절차가 빨라 호주 환자들이 아시아로 몰리고 있다. 호주 현지 치과의사들은 해외 진료에 고객을 뺏길까 봐 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: More Australians Travel to Vietnam for Cheap Dental Care

items.title_original: Vietnam wants to grow dental tourism, which has Australian dentists worried

items.raw_excerpt: The City of Toronto has issued an "order to remedy unsafe building" to Live Nation Canada about the state of Rogers Stadium after the concert venue was damaged by Wednesday's severe thunderstorm.
items.summary_en: The City of Toronto told Live Nation Canada to fix Rogers Stadium after a severe thunderstorm caused significant damage. The city issued an official order to remedy the unsafe building conditions at the concert venue.

items.title_original: City orders Live Nation Canada to repair Rogers Stadium after 'significant damage'

items.raw_excerpt: Ben White will take "Gladys" to an RHS show later this month.

items.raw_excerpt: The former industrial site is "the last major development site available" near the CBD, "close to all the things people need and want", MP Tim Nicholls says.
items.summary_en: Brisbane city leaders have approved a large housing project on a former industrial waterfront site near the city center. The development will include 2,200 new homes, but none will be priced as affordable housing.

items.raw_excerpt: Mim Strom's afternoon comes to a premature end due to a shoulder injury, but she still finds a way to make an impact on Fremantle's win over Richmond.
items.summary_en: Mim Strom left the field early with a shoulder injury during Fremantle's AFLW match against Richmond. Despite being hurt, she stepped into a coaching role from the sideline and helped guide her team to victory.

items.raw_excerpt: The first night of the "Trois éléphants passent ..." street performance drew around 100,000 Taiwanese and foreign spectators to the streets of Taipei's Shilin District on Saturday, the opening night, with another performance scheduled for Sunday, according to the Taipei Performing Arts Center (TPAC).
items.summary_en: A giant mechanical elephant called Trois éléphants passent performed on the streets of Taipei's Shilin District. About 100,000 people watched the opening night on Saturday. The street show continues with another performance on Sunday.

items.title_en: Giant mechanical elephant street show opens in Taipei
